title: Accra Afterglow — Christmas & Culture
summary: Five vibrant days of art, heritage, coastal relaxation and the unmistakable energy of Accra at Christmas. Discover Ghana at your own pace, with flights, a comfortable city stay and the essentials thoughtfully arranged.

runs.text: Some destinations know how to celebrate. Accra pairs warm hospitality with music, irresistible food, art spaces and Atlantic sunsets. This five-day escape gives you the city's essential experiences and enough freedom to discover your own favourite corners.
Your journey, day by day
Day 1 — Arrive in Accra. Fly from Lagos, meet your transfer representative and check into your city hotel. Enjoy an unhurried evening and a first taste of Ghanaian cuisine.
Day 2 — Discover the capital. Explore Independence Square, the Kwame Nkrumah Memorial Park area and a colourful local market with a guide. The afternoon is yours for cafés and shopping.
Day 3 — Accra's creative side. Enjoy an arts and culture outing, then head toward the coast for sea air and a relaxed sunset. Choose an optional festive event in the evening.
Day 4 — Make it personal. Free time for a private beach visit, family activities, extra sightseeing or the festive energy of the city. Optional ticketed concerts can be arranged on request.
Day 5 — A final Ghanaian breakfast, a relaxed checkout and your return airport transfer for the flight to Lagos.

Day 4 — Discover Nairobi. Spend time at selected city landmarks, cafés and markets, with space for shopping or an optional museum experience.
Day 5 — Enjoy breakfast, check out and take your scheduled airport transfer for your journey home.

runs.text: Soft sand. Indian Ocean breezes. Sunsets that make you forget the clock. Zanzibar is made for couples, friends and travellers who want a beautiful change of pace, with a thoughtful balance of beach leisure and genuine island discovery.
Your journey, day by day
Day 1 — Fly to Zanzibar and meet your transfer for the journey to your beach resort. Unpack, settle in and watch the light change over the coast.
Day 2 — Island time. Enjoy breakfast and a relaxed beach day, with space for swimming, reading and oceanfront dining.
Day 3 — Stories and spices. Explore the distinctive streets of Stone Town and visit a traditional spice farm with a local guide.
Day 4 — Out on the ocean. Take a guided sandbank or reef excursion with snorkelling equipment, subject to safe sea conditions.
Day 5 — Your island, your way. Enjoy a second beach day, a wellness treatment or an optional sunset dhow experience.
Day 6 — Breakfast, checkout and your transfer to the airport for the return journey.

Day 3 — Table Mountain. Enjoy the world-famous cableway journey when conditions allow, followed by time for viewpoints and the city.
Day 4 — Cape Peninsula. Take a scenic coastal drive with stops around Cape Point and the Boulders Beach penguin area.
Day 5 — The city at your pace. Enjoy a relaxed day for cafés, galleries, beaches or a personalised excursion.
Day 6 — A final Cape Town experience. Enjoy a planned harbour or sunset cruise, with the rest of the day yours for a memorable farewell.
Day 7 — Breakfast, checkout and transfer for your return flight.

runs.text: A place where futuristic architecture, lush tropical spaces and rich neighbourhood traditions feel perfectly at home together. Our Singapore Signature journey pairs waterfront evenings and extraordinary gardens with the food, culture and leisure experiences that make the city unforgettable.
Your journey, day by day

Day 1 — Arrive in Singapore. Meet your airport transfer representative, settle into your selected hotel and enjoy a relaxed first evening. Your adviser will tailor flight routing and arrival timing before booking.

Day 2 — Marina Bay and the city icons. Discover the waterfront, civic precinct and celebrated skyline. Continue to Gardens by the Bay for the outdoor Supertree Grove and the planned Cloud Forest and Flower Dome experience, subject to their operating schedules.
Day 3 — Heritage, flavours and discovery. Explore Chinatown and Kampong Gelam with a guide. Discover colourful streets, heritage architecture and local dining, with time to explore at your own pace.
Day 4 — Sentosa Island. Enjoy a full island day with scenic coastal surroundings and leisure opportunities. Choose optional attractions or a relaxed beach afternoon to suit your travel style.
Day 5 — Singapore your way. Discover Little India, the Singapore River or another favourite neighbourhood, or use the day for shopping, dining and personal experiences.
Day 6 — A leisurely checkout and airport transfer for your return journey to Nigeria, according to your confirmed flight itinerary.
